feat: Phase 5 - Implement rotation offset calculation for multi-tile buildings

Added calculate_building_world_position() function to support multi-tile building
placement with proper rotation handling (Unity GridBuildingSystem3D pattern):

**New Function:**
- calculate_building_world_position(grid_origin, building_id, rotation, grid_size)
  - Looks up building dimensions from building_data
  - Converts world size to grid cells (width/height)
  - Uses existing get_rotation_offset() from Phase 1
  - Applies offset: base_world + rotation_offset * cell_size
  - Returns world position with rotation offset applied

**Purpose:**
Enables proper placement of multi-tile buildings (2x1, 3x2, etc.) at all rotations.
When a 2x1 building rotates 90°, it becomes 1x2 in grid space - the rotation offset
ensures it stays grid-aligned.

**Integration:**
Ready for use in future multi-tile building implementation (workbenches, assemblers).
Current 1x1 buildings (walls, floors) work without needing this function.

Refs: docs/BUILDING_SYSTEM_OVERHAUL.md Phase 5
